arguments.name: fill
arguments.text: One value, or three values for the left, interior, and right. A single "extend" is an error, and the interior component cannot be "extend".

arguments.name: ix
arguments.text: TRUE at positions that are kept. Defaults to the non-missing entries.

origin.details: Works on plain vectors. A length-one numeric fill replaces every unselected position. NULL components drop those positions instead of filling them.
origin.value: The filled vector. c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) filled with 0 returns 1, 0, 3, 0, 0.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.fill0(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA), 0)
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
